title: Hidden Item Frame
body:
**Invisible Item Frames** is a clean resource pack that removes the wooden border and background from item frames. This makes items look like they are placed directly on blocks, creating a much better look for decorations and storage.

**Features**


- Fully Transparent: Only the item inside the frame is visible.

- Support: Works for both regular and Glowing Item Frames.

- No Lag: Lightweight textures that don't affect FPS.

- Server Ready: Works on any server or world without needing mods.
